title: Perch wire schema index
description: Every schema in this directory, what carries it, and where the values came from. Seventeen files: 7 card schemas + 7 frame schemas + the kind:46010 event schema + common.schema.json + card-envelope.schema.json. Normative companion: docs/plans/ambush-ui/build/13-WIRE-SCHEMAS.md. The HTTP contract these cards are read back against is docs/plans/ambush-ui/build/openapi/perch-operator-v1.yaml, and the two are held together by tools/check-perch-wire-parity.sh (PROPOSED; delivered as skeleton/perch-wire/parity-gate.sh, which runs green from either tree with no env vars and carries a --self-test).
